CHARACTER DOSSIER · VERSION 3.6

QINGXIAO

The guide explains not only what every skill says, but why that skill exists, what resource it creates, when you use it, and how it connects to the next part of the rotation.

AEROSWORD5★MAIN DPS
清宵

Skills

Active · Passive · Concerto · Core mechanic

AA
BASIC ATTACK

Stringblade

Qingxiao performs a four-hit Normal Attack chain. Stages 1 and 4 are Sheathed Stance; stages 2 and 3 are Drawn Stance. Her mid-air version continues the Drawn Stance flow.

Why it matters: her Basic Attack is not filler. It is the main way she generates the two resources needed to unlock her enhanced phase.
HA
HEAVY ATTACK

Stringblade

Once Qin Heart and Sword Cadence are full, this Heavy Attack becomes available. It consumes both resources and enters Ephemeral Transcendence.

Why it matters: this is the bridge between the setup phase and Qingxiao's real payoff sequence.
RS
RESONANCE SKILL

Severing Note

Judgement deals Aero DMG and grants 45 Qin Heart. During certain Basic Attack / Dodge Counter states it changes into Ascendant, which is a Drawn Stance attack.

Why it matters: Judgement is the major accelerator for the Qin Heart side of the setup, while Ascendant keeps the Drawn Stance flow moving.
RL
RESONANCE LIBERATION

Billows Beneath Heaven

Deals a large burst of Aero DMG and can be cast close to the ground while Qingxiao is airborne.

Why it matters: it is one of her major damage events and also refreshes Heaven's Clarity, so its timing matters to the next cycle.
Active-skill mental model: Basic Attacks and Skill prepare the resources; Stringblade converts them into the enhanced state; Liberation is part of the payoff window.
FORTE CIRCUIT

Ephemeral Transcendence

After Heavy Attack — Stringblade consumes Qin Heart and Sword Cadence, Qingxiao enters Ephemeral Transcendence. Her normal attacks become enhanced attacks and can be used in mid-air.

Gameplay: stop building the first two resources. Your only goal now is Heart Sword Intent.
FORTE PAYOFF

Heaven's Reckoning

When Heart Sword Intent reaches 100, Heavy Attack — Heaven's Reckoning becomes available. It consumes the entire resource and ends Ephemeral Transcendence.

Gameplay: this is the reason the entire setup exists. You want to reach this attack quickly without interrupting the enhanced sequence.
MINDLOCK

Target amplification

Mindlock can reach 15 stacks. Qingxiao's listed core attacks deal increased damage based on the target's Mindlock, with a stronger bonus on the first seven stacks.

Gameplay: Tune Strain teammates are valuable because they help the team build the target state that Qingxiao converts into personal damage.
HEAVEN'S CLARITY

Faster setup + enhanced payoff

Qingxiao gains Heaven's Clarity on entering combat and after casting Liberation. While active, her Sheathed / Drawn resource generation is accelerated, and Heavy Attack — Stringblade grants Mindlock while empowering the next Heaven's Reckoning.

Critical detail: swapping away during the enhanced Heaven's Reckoning preparation removes that enhancement, so the payoff phase should normally be completed on Qingxiao.
SWORDLIGHT WARD

One-hit protection

Intro Skill and Heavy Attack — Stringblade grant a Swordlight Ward. It can absorb one enemy hit, granting interruption immunity and reducing damage taken for a short period.

Gameplay: this is useful because Qingxiao commits to a long on-field sequence and does not want to be interrupted before her payoff.
SWORD FLIGHT

Aerial movement

Several attacks send Qingxiao into Sword Flight. Movement consumes Flight Qi, and Sword Step provides an additional short aerial dash.

Gameplay: this is both mobility and part of her identity as an aerial DPS. It also helps her maintain contact with airborne targets.
INTRO SKILL

Tonality Shift

Deals Aero DMG and grants 30 Sword Cadence plus Resonant Chime.

Resonant Chime: the next Resonance Skill — Judgement grants another 30 Qin Heart and removes the Chime. This means the Intro directly accelerates the opening resource setup.
OUTRO SKILL

Lingering Song

Deals Aero DMG based on Qingxiao's ATK when she leaves the field.

Gameplay: her Outro is part of the value of completing the field sequence, so your rotation should have a deliberate exit rather than endlessly extending Qingxiao's field time.
Concerto in one sentence: Intro gets Qingxiao closer to her first Heavy Attack; Outro turns the completed sequence into additional team-cycle value.
THE WHOLE KIT

Three resource phases

Sheathed → Qin Heart+Drawn → Sword Cadence→Stringblade→Ephemeral Transcendence→Heart Sword Intent→Heaven's Reckoning

Phase 1 — Prepare

Fill Qin Heart and Sword Cadence.

Phase 2 — Transform

Spend both resources with Stringblade and enter the enhanced state.

Phase 3 — Cash out

Build Heart Sword Intent and spend it on Heaven's Reckoning.

Review

Strength, weaknesses, investment and who she suits.

SINGLE TARGET

Very strong

Qingxiao is built to concentrate a large amount of damage into a focused target through her Tune Strain / Mindlock interaction.

PLAYSTYLE

Long committed field time

Her rotation is mechanically simple once understood, but she wants to finish the enhanced sequence instead of constantly quick-swapping.

TEAM REQUIREMENT

High

Her performance improves dramatically when the team can support her Tune Strain plan. Denia + Mornye is the premium route; Lynae gives another route with more support flexibility.

Why you would build her

  • Excellent single-target pressure.
  • Aerial combat makes boss encounters visually and mechanically distinctive.
  • Very straightforward inputs after the opening setup.
  • Strong payoff when the team maintains the correct target state.

Why you might skip her

  • She is expensive to optimize because her best teams are specialized.
  • Multi-wave / AoE situations can be less comfortable than single-target fights.
  • Her enhanced phase discourages frequent character swapping.
  • Her value depends heavily on what Tune Strain supports you already own.
SEQUENCE INVESTMENT

How to think about S0 → S6

S1: adds Crit Rate and introduces extra Exorcising Seal / Juque Perdition value. S2: improves Stringblade and raises Mindlock / Gathered Mind limits. S3: heavily improves Liberation and Heaven's Reckoning scaling. S4: gives the team an ATK benefit when Tune Strain is inflicted. S5: improves Judgement and Sword Flight efficiency. S6: is the major premium damage ceiling.

For the guide, present S0 as the baseline and treat higher Sequences as investment options rather than requirements for the character to function.

Echoes

The set should support her Tune Strain loop.

BEST SONATA

Heart of Evil's Purge — 5pc

The set gives Aero DMG and adds Crit DMG plus further Aero DMG after the relevant Tune Strain condition is met. Qingxiao can activate that condition naturally, making the set a direct match for her gameplay.

Fallback: Sierra Gale is the conventional Aero alternative while building the dedicated set.
MAIN ECHO

Calamity Effigy

Use it as the dedicated 4-Cost Main Echo for the Heart of Evil's Purge setup. It supplies additional Aero support and can be used near the end of Qingxiao's damage sequence before the team handoff.

Rotation tip: place the Echo late enough that you don't interrupt the important enhanced sequence, then use it close to the Outro / swap.

Substat priority

Energy Regen until comfortable→CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG→ATK%→Flat ATK→Heavy / Liberation / Basic DMG%

Energy requirements depend on the team and rotation. Once the Liberation is consistently ready on time, Crit becomes the main optimization target.

Skill priority

Spend resources where they change the actual damage loop.

1 · Forte Circuit→2 · Resonance Liberation→3 · Basic Attack→4 · Resonance Skill→5 · Intro Skill
Why: Forte contains the enhanced state and Heaven's Reckoning payoff; Liberation is a major damage event; Basic Attack is used throughout the resource and enhanced phases. Intro and Skill can be left behind if you need to save materials, with a relatively small loss.

Gameplay & Rotations

Rotation, Echo timing, team synergies and practical alternatives.

STANDARD ROTATION

Simple inputs, deliberate resource timing

Intro→Mid-air Stringblade ×3→Basic Stringblade 3 → 4→Judgement→Stringblade Heavy→Transcendence 1–4→Heaven's Reckoning→Liberation→Echo→Outro
1 · OPENING

Intro → Stringblade sequence

Tonality Shift gives Sword Cadence and Resonant Chime. Continue through the Stringblade sequence to build the remaining Qin Heart / Sword Cadence requirements while staying in the aerial flow.

What you're watching: you're preparing the Heavy Attack that starts Ephemeral Transcendence.
2 · ACCELERATOR

Judgement

Use Severing Note: Judgement after the initial Stringblade sequence. It provides a large Qin Heart injection and, with Resonant Chime, accelerates the setup even further.

Don't drift: the point of the Skill is to finish the first resource phase, not to create a separate damage rotation.
3 · TRANSITION

Heavy Attack — Stringblade

Once the resources are full, cast the Heavy Attack. It consumes the setup resources, grants Mindlock and starts the enhanced state.

Important: swapping here is usually a bad idea because it removes the enhancement tied to the upcoming Heaven's Reckoning.
4 · ENHANCED PHASE

Transcendence 1–4

Continue holding Normal Attack through the enhanced sequence. These attacks build Heart Sword Intent and benefit from the target's Mindlock.

Goal: don't overcomplicate this section. Keep the target in range and build the final resource.
5 · PAYOFF

Heaven's Reckoning

At full Heart Sword Intent, cast the enhanced Heavy Attack. This consumes the resource and ends Ephemeral Transcendence.

This is the payoff: the whole preceding sequence is designed to make this hit as valuable as possible.
6 · CLOSE

Liberation → Echo → Outro

Use Billows Beneath Heaven, then your Echo late in the cycle and transition through the Outro. The Echo is ideally placed close to the end of the rotation and can be swap-cancelled.

Why late? You want the major Qingxiao damage sequence completed before leaving the field.

Echo timing

One of the easiest optimization points to explain in the video.

Recommended placement: after Liberation and immediately before the Outro / swap. This lets the Echo contribute without interrupting the enhanced Qingxiao sequence and keeps the rotation compact.

Heaven's Reckoning→Liberation→Calamity Effigy→Outro / Swap

Team synergies

Qingxiao is not a “put her anywhere” DPS.

CORE PARTNER

Denia + Mornye

Denia is the strongest hybrid partner in the premium setup, while Mornye supplies the specialized Tune Strain support and additional buffs that make the pair work together.

Why this pair matters: Qingxiao's damage scales with how effectively the team maintains the Tune Strain / Mindlock ecosystem. Denia without Mornye suffers a substantial team-performance loss.
FLEX ROUTE

Lynae + Mornye

Lynae provides a more flexible hybrid route with Tune Strain application and broad support value. Mornye remains the preferred partner when available.

Use this when: you have Lynae but don't have the ideal Denia setup.
SUPPORT ALTERNATIVES

Ciaccona / Shorekeeper

When Lynae is your hybrid partner, Ciaccona or Shorekeeper can fill the support slot with a smaller loss than trying to replace Mornye in the Denia pairing.

Trade-off: you gain account flexibility, but give up some of the specialized Tune Strain amplification.
TEAM BUILDING RULE

Buff the payoff, not random hits

The team should prepare the target, provide buffs, then hand the field to Qingxiao for the committed enhanced sequence. Avoid teams that constantly force her to swap during Ephemeral Transcendence.

Example teams

Presented as practical team archetypes rather than a single mandatory answer.

QX
Qingxiao · Denia · Mornye
Premium Tune Strain route — strongest dedicated setup and the benchmark team for her release.
QX
Qingxiao · Lynae · Mornye
Flexible hybrid route — retains strong Tune Strain support while opening a different account-building path.
QX
Qingxiao · Lynae · Ciaccona
Support-flex route — use when Mornye is unavailable and you want to keep Lynae as the hybrid enabler.
QX
Qingxiao · Lynae · Shorekeeper
Comfort / sustain route — sacrifices some specialization for a safer, more universally useful support option.

Quick practice checklist

If these five things happen, the rotation is working.

✓ Setup

Qin Heart and Sword Cadence fill without unnecessary downtime.

✓ Transition

Stringblade starts Ephemeral Transcendence at the intended time.

✓ Payoff

Heaven's Reckoning is cast with the intended Mindlock / buff setup.
